title: Japanese Wagyu Skewers with Teriyaki Sauce
description: Marinate Wagyu beef in a sweet teriyaki sauce and grill to perfection on skewers. Serve as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sake, honey, grated ginger, and garlic.
2. Add the Wagyu beef cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread the marinated Wagyu beef onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush the skewers with sesame oil and season with salt and pepper.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the Wagyu beef is cooked to desired doneness.
8. Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions.
